metadata.description: Plugins by Egor Fedorov: context-optimizer (a live cost and context meter, Haiku subagents, handoffs and document digests), second-opinion (a background review of every Claude Code turn), project-brain (a living project dossier for chat, Cowork and Code) and cco-arcade.

plugins.name: context-optimizer
plugins.description: See what Claude costs you and spend less of it. In chat: hand a long chat over to a new one, digest long documents, set up Projects, check tokens, sharpen prompts. In Claude Code: a live line with context, cost, plan limits and the cache countdown; Haiku 5.5 subagents for reading and test runs; /cco audit of your own transcripts. Local, no telemetry.

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: After every Claude Code turn that changed code, Haiku 5.5 reviews the diff in the background and pins a one-line verdict under the prompt: a removed check, a broken contract, leftover debug code. Click for details or ask Claude to fix it.

plugins.name: project-brain
plugins.description: A living dossier for any ongoing project: decisions with reasons, numbers, agreements, open questions and next steps, kept up to date as you talk and carried into a new chat or a Claude Project in one step. claude.ai chat, Cowork and Claude Code.

plugins.name: cco-arcade
plugins.description: The waiting game for Claude Code: live session dashboard + idle 'Token City' fed by your real agent activity (Godzilla wrecks it if you stop coding), plus desktop/phone pings when Claude finishes or needs you
